notes.title: MULTIPLAYER
notes.content:
Multiplayer has finally arrived and is fully playable! You can try guys playing with your friends on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646785/6494c2e37cc91e52f7c52ada4ea0dfa67dbeed2a.png

MULTIPLAYER FEATURES:
- full steam integration showing friends, avatars, allowing for invites and join
- hosting and searching for public servers
- Steam Presence tell you if your friends are playing, are in lobby or the main menu
- lobby functionality, chat, kick, ready, countdown
- multiplayer savegame system allowing to save and create a new game from the savegame

GAME MECHANICS ADAPTED FOR MULTIPLAYER:
- grid mechanics - construction, destruction, rotation, turning devices off, recycling
- separate technology tree for each player
- shared technology points
- third person characters look with new animations
- characters movement, position, tools are replicated and saved
- water networks
- electric networks
- conveyor and resource movement
- AI and movement
- asteroids - are fully replicated - players know when asteroids are hit and destroyed
- interaction - asteroid catcher, harpoon, docking systems
- voxels - adding and removing
- Vehicles and more!

notes.title: Harpoon connector & Chinese language
notes.content:
Update is adding Chinese language, which can be selected in the Interface settings.
The game is now spawning planetoids (fragmented planets) which can be attracted by a Harpoon Connector.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646785/5881a48eff24f0249e7e364dd61c40a35fa4d976.png

Additional QOL and bug fixes:

 Toasts are not anymore staying on the screen when moving to the Pause Menu or Map
 Fixed tutorial with astronauts training
 QOL - tutorials for drill and harpoon docking
 QOL - tutorial step to teach player how to use mouse (opening a guide) ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646785/9496a8777328f90249c3d47485e1e87465050988.png

notes.title: Drills, windows stay open, recyclables used for construction!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646785/e57d025351389bc271193dabca130d08ccf8966f.png

In this update drills are added to Astro Colony. It's a new exciting way of extracting resources from the ground!
Use them to mine Quartz, Stone or any other resource!

Meanwhile we are experimenting with balance and tech tree changes.
For example Chemistry is now required to reaseach Advanced Mining (Miners). It creates a need of having Astronauts sooner!

Opened menus from devices and inventory (like crafting) will stay open and remember it's state.

You can now destroy devices and use recyclables back to construct them again!

In addition many fixes and small QOL improvements:

 Each device by default has maximum workers assigned
 Fixed issue with multiple drones assigned to the workplace at the same time
 Fixed issue with surface details (planet foliage) not being generated or generated in wrong places (other space station)
 Fixed some visuals not updated after device rotation
 Fixed crafting issue, where saving was pushing progress by few %
 Docking station easier to construct on the planet - clear space in front when constructed

notes.title: Transport bots can now transport absolutely anything!
notes.content:
In this update Transport Bots system was upgraded to the state, where each device can create their own requests for resources. Bots will figure out and balance resources in your network!

Bug fixes:
- Fixed space station selection, so more starting stations can be picked
- Fixed recent tech tree problems
- Holograms are better visible
- Conveyor belts improved with new speed for ramps
- Transport bots are now able to transport all resources from any device like (Farm, Mine or Canteen)

notes.title: Steam achievements
notes.content:
In this update 16 achievements got added to Astro Colony. Majority of them can be already unlocked. 
Additionally, many fixes and balance changes.

FIXES
- fixed the issue where astronaut face is not visible when moving
- fixed the Auto Catcher issue showing wrong effect after loading and upgrading
- energy transmitter can now regulate amount of transmitted energy
- improved movement and asteroid spawning while moving
- fixed effects and particles for movement

BALANCE CHANGES
- Asteroid Catcher now sooner in the tree
- Floors construction now require construction technology
- Basic science points can now be researched later in the game
- Electricity balanced - Fusion, Nuclear, Carbon, Solar

notes.title: Functional Battery + fixes
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/QCZ4RIH.png
Battery is now functional!

Other changes:
- fixed crash when opening detail menu for devices
- fixed issue with heads of astronauts not being loaded
- improved water system, better and faster calculations for giant water networks
- more signal disable states implemented
- fixed crashes with caused by Networks
- languages updated

notes.title: Signal transmission
notes.content:
In this update we are testing signal and logic blocks adding possibility to send signals from one station to another with fully functional Antenna/Signal Receiver

Other changes:

 Logic blocks can now be disabled
 Crafting devices can now be disabled
 Signal can be transmitted from Antenna to Receiver
 Remote fabricator - new device added
 Antenna can now send the signal
 Signal Receiver can now receive the signal

notes.title: Logic Signals
notes.content:
The update adds a system of logical blocks and the ability to turn off each device separately.
The sensor recognizes the inventory state and sends the appropriate signal.
An arithmetic block can process this signal. Logic decider controls the state of the devices.

Additionally, numerous minor improvements and fixes:

 Logic Signals: Signal cable, Sensor, Arithmetic, Decider, 
 Version system capable of converting savegames between versions
 Fixes: energy transmitter/receiver, astronauts and other
 New metahumans
 Optimized gameplay and the game size

notes.content: Hotfix for Astronauts, conveyor belt resources and transport bots

notes.title: Japanese language and docking station fixes
notes.content:
皆さん、こんにちは! In this update Japanese language becomes available! Thanks to our Discord community member Mechanical Hive! Some additional changes:
- docking station no longer disconnects when loading
- possibility to forget space station and planet on the map
- fix - splitting resources no longer cuts the number

notes.title: Exploits killer -_-
notes.content:
New update is here, which is killing many exploits in the game!
- free construction is not anymore possible ːsteammockingː
- docking from a very far distance is not anymore possible ːsteammockingː
- more improvements for farmers, miners, breeders and astronauts
- astronauts should not anymore be trapped by docking station
- migration starts right after dock is created (before required new devices being constructed)
- vehicles fitting docking station

notes.title: Multi-station selection, astronauts walking on conveyor belts
notes.content:
In this update, many improvements have been added to the game.

 Selecting elements from multiple space stations is now possible
 Astronauts are now can walk on conveyor belts
 More cases where nudge and swap is used, so Astronauts finds the way to destination
 Turn Left/Right is now exposed to settings and can be changed
 Added missing recipes, so every possible item in the game can be crafted
 Fix - Docking station no more blocks resources because of invalid conveyor belt

notes.title: Russian language and fixes
notes.content:
Добрый вечер! In this update Russian language becomes available! Thanks to our Discord community member Abotur, who helped to translate Russian phrases! Additional changes:
- vehicle designer is more reliable and not causes crashes when other devices are working
- on screen markers are now always remove when scanning effect is gone
- dirt has a new 3d model and translated names

notes.title: Thrusters, Dirt, Barn / Farm tooltips and bugfixes
notes.content:
In this update, Thrusters got reworked. Each thruster can now go directly up and down, so it's possible to create as pace elevator! There is also a new resource DIRT - mined on planets, required when placing a new voxel. Other changes:

- Fixed issues with control panel not setting thrusters correct direction 
- Animals and plants tooltips added
- Farm, Barn, Mine shows produced resources in details panel
- fixed an issue where dirt can be placed to generate infinite Quartz or Stone
- fixed an issue where pipe resource is blocked by near devices
- fixed an issue with splitting resources 1000 and more

notes.title: New Barn, nine tiles pastures, tomato soup
notes.content:
This updates changes how Barn works, adding 9 tiles requirement for cows. All recipes are available, so go ahead and try to produce some meat, eggs, milk or wool!

In addition many bug fixes and improvements:
- speed of pushing resources depends on conveyor belt is push into
- fixed the issue where scanning indicators stays on the screen
- constructed vehicles are now attached to the station they are on
- new vehicles recovery
- vehicles now are destroyed if they fall
- flying vehicles stays in landing state when loading the game
- new improved docking, fixing problem with space stations "jumping"
- new billboards (ex. grain)
- new icons for sizes and resources
- splitting the item appears next to split one

notes.title: Farms, barns improvements and more fixes
notes.content:
This time farmers got greatly improved with more reliable farm behaviors.
In addition, there were performance improvements and bug fixes.
- crash fixes for astronauts
- drones no more getting stuck on farms
- farms with 4 tiles (ex. trees) are now correctly working
- overlapping decals no longer stays after removing

notes.title: More fixes for AI, movement and path-finding
notes.content:
In this update more fixes and changes for planets:
- miners no longer confused about rocks blocking path to the resource
- climbing is now easier, ramps no longer spawn on the edges of cliffs
- transferred AI cancellation
- new aerial pathfinding for drones

- savegame time is now correct, override save updates time
